command: set -u; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; date -Is; echo '===HOST==='; uptime; nproc; free -m; echo '===SERVICE==='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service || true; systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager || true; echo '===WINDOWS==='; DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --name 'FranKenstein -- live' 2>/dev/null | while read w; do echo WINDOW_ID=$w; DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell $w 2>/dev/null || true; DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowname $w 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '===CHROME_PROCESSES==='; ps -eo pid=,ppid=,args= | grep -E '[c]hrome|[c]hromium' | grep -E '127\.0\.0\.1:8788|chrome-profile|FranKenstein|--kiosk' || true; echo '===DISPLAY_MAP==='; DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --query 2>/dev/null | grep -E ' connected|current ' || true
